cause_of_death: Blunt force trauma to cranial region
report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Arjun Mehta | Age: 29
Body Temperature at Scene: 21.0°C | Ambient Temperature: 29.4°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 17.6 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  2. Dorsal: Pattern bruising consistent with impact [MODERATE]
  3. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]
  4. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): GHB

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
